crossRefs.note: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Turn and, behold, I am with you according to your heart.”
Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light, and…
The king’s servants said to the king, “Behold, your servants are ready to do whatever my lord the king chooses.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”
translations.bsb: Then Saul said to all Israel, “You stand on one side, and I and my son Jonathan will stand on the other side.” “Do what seems good to you,” the troops replied.
translations.kjv: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.
translations.asv: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.
